import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        boolean[] used = new boolean[p];
        int t = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            if (!used[i]) {
                t++;
                dfs(i, p, k, used);
            }
        }

        long ans = 1;
        int limit = t + (k == 1 ? 1 : 0);
        for (int i = 1; i < limit; i++) {
            ans = (ans * p) % 1000000007;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }

    private static void dfs(int x, int p, int k, boolean[] used) {
        used[x] = true;
        int to = (int)(((long) x * k) % p);
        if (!used[to]) {
            dfs(to, p, k, used);
        }
    }
}
